facts.text: The architect (applicant, licensed building practitioner) and Auckland Council (authority) dispute which Acceptable Solution, C/AS1 or C/AS2, applies to the proposed building work for Clause C compliance.
The proposed accommodation at 64A Rosella Road, Mangere East has six units: four with eight bedrooms and two with seven bedrooms, with no access between adjacent units.
Adjacent units are joined by a double-stud party wall rated FRR 60 (60 minutes); figures 1 to 3 show a site plan, elevation and ground-floor plan (not to scale).
Each unit has two ground-floor doors opening to a foyer with a shared laundry; common kitchen and living areas are on the upper level; bedrooms have lockable entry doors and no cooking facilities.
